The '''2a fission engine''' or '''2a Ion fission engine''' was a significant product manufactured by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] in use by wide variety of governments and private customers.

==Details==
[[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom's]] [[ion fission engine]]s were a simple and reliable way to propel modest sized ships like a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], but due to the [[Nuclear fission|fission]] power generator nature of the engine, it used highly [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] propellants that needed to be cautiously manipulated. Four Incom 2a fission engines usually propelled the Z-95/AF4 Headhunter frame in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]]. One unit was located on the dorsal and ventral surfaces of each wing. In [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], these fission engines worked in conjunction with recessed repulsorlift generators to attain speeds of 1,150 kilometers per hour.

==History==
The 2a Fission Engines started production at [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]] production lines to equip the last version of the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]], the AF4 model.
